spec.claim_summary: Buy Nikkei 225 stocks when daily close crosses above the 80-day +1 sigma Bollinger upper band, exiting when close crosses below the 80-day middle band.
spec.untestable_reason: Aggregate portfolio backtest across all 225 Nikkei constituents cannot be replicated by a single-asset one-position-at-a-time test.
assumptions: Upper +1 sigma line is Bollinger bb_upper with period 80 and width param 1; middle band is the 80-day SMA middle line per standard Bollinger definition.
Entry and exit fill at the next bar's open per engine default, matching next-day open market orders.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim requires an aggregate portfolio backtest across all 225 Nikkei 225 constituents with potentially concurrent positions; the engine tests a single asset one position at a time, so the single NIKKEI225 ticker is a placeholder only and testing it would not replicate the claimed diversified-constituents result.

evidence.quote: Buy at the next day’s open using a market order
Period: Fixed at 80 days … Upper and lower bands: Fixed at ±1σ … Setup: Price crosses above the +1σ line from below
If the price crosses below the middle band, sell at the next day’s open using a market order

audit_majors: testable: Mechanical core is fully specified and could be tested: daily long Bollinger(80, +/-1 sigma) close crosses above upper for entry, close crosses below middle/SMA80 for exit. Portfolio aggregation across 225 constituents affects exact win-rate replication but does not make the rule untestable on a single asset like NIKKEI225 daily.
